remarks: Welcome to this amazing Orchard Park home and property. Originally from 1850, 6097 Seufert Rd. has been transformed into a beautiful 3 bedrooms 2 bath home situated on 5+ acres. Wait till you see all of the impressive finishes throughout. Enter the open 2 story foyer with gorgeous plank wood walls. The spacious bright great room highlights a custom gas fireplace, crown molding, rear wall of windows with a built-in window seat, & laminate flooring. The large formal dining room has wide custom trim, crown molding, and laminate flooring. Superb kitchen with quartz countertops, oversized breakfast bar island, stainless steel appliances, beautiful, upgraded cabinets, pantry with a barn door. The 1st floor laundry room also offers a tiled dog bath. Enjoy the enclosed rear seasonal room with wonderful views of your private yard. A first-floor full bath offers a tiled walk-in shower, tiled floor and Corian vanity. The second floor offers 3 bedrooms and another full bath. Hardwood floors. Master bedroom with a stunning cathedral barn wood ceiling. 2 W/I closets, lots of closets & storage. Newer Pella windows, cent. air. updated plumbing, electrical, & fixtures. There are 5 buildings on the property - a 30' x 60' - two 30' x 30' - a 2-car garage/storage building - hen house - & the original grain house from 1850. Lovely, mature trees with a garden - fruit trees, berry bushes. There is a fenced area for your pets. Additional square feet was added with the 2019 upgrades & updates. Relax on the rear wood deck or the full-length front porch. Country living at its best! Minutes to the village of Orchard Park, Chestnut Ridge Park. Green Lake, shopping, golf course, & restaurants, Orchard Park schools.
